archetype: highway filling station and convenience store
public_program: sales floor with checkout sightline to the entrance and pumps
four short merchandise aisle runs with cross aisles
refrigerated cases along the east wall
public restroom accessible from the sales floor
staff_program: stock and receiving room with rear delivery exit
three pump islands beneath a freestanding canopy
two buried steel fuel tanks in a reinforced inspection vault
refuse enclosure and roof mechanical plant
circulation: highway apron through the pump lanes to parking and storefront walk
customer doors to checkout and cross-aisle sales circulation
sales floor through controlled doors to stockroom, office and utility rooms
stockroom to independent rear receiving exit
damage_constraints: preserve the storefront entrance and checkout sightline
retain a route from sales floor to stockroom, manager office and rear exit
concentrate canopy failure in the east pump lane
concentrate building failure in the southeast utility corner
shape rubble beneath failed roof and wall members
derive all abandoned variants from the immutable clean master

required_manual_checks: the property reads as a filling station from the highway
vehicle, pedestrian and delivery approaches are distinct
checkout, aisles, coolers and restroom have usable player-scale clearances
stockroom, office, utility and receiving functions have credible adjacencies
canopy, pumps, sign, service cabinet and roof plant form a coherent operational system
subterranean tank vault aligns beneath the pump forecourt and remains fully buried after placement
damage preserves the original business and follows structural gravity
